question: Can physically named rooted/source-to-landing connectivity responses fill the exact 2 trivial, 2 charge-one and 3 charge-two dimensions missing from the width-four grade-one Q-adic layer, without adding another terminal character?

AP.meaning: source i is joined to adjacent landing i+1 and the other two sites remain singleton

OP.meaning: source i is joined to opposite landing i+2 and the other two sites remain singleton

DP.meaning: the source-adjacent pair and complementary landing pair are both retained

response_contract.raw_column: For rooted reference tau use c_tau=d/dQ G(Q)[:,tau] at Q=1, exactly the corresponding column of G1.
response_contract.no_fit: All coefficients are frozen C4 character projectors; no endpoint column or amplitude is fitted.

decision_rule.complete: Each sector gains exactly its frozen deficit and the combined old-plus-rooted grade-one response matrix has rank thirteen.
decision_rule.incomplete: Report the deficient sector, exact rank and a primitive left-null functional annihilating every old-plus-rooted response in that sector.
decision_rule.minimality: Seven new coordinates is the dimension lower bound 2+2+3. Reaching rank thirteen with seven proves minimality within linear grade-one completion.

covariance_gate.translation: AP rotates as a four-cycle; OP and DP rotate as two-cycles. The projected action is I_2 on the two trivial coordinates, the standard C4 charge-one rotation on the AP doublet, and -I_3 on the three charge-two coordinates.
covariance_gate.required: Both raw response columns and their H-dual grade-one vectors must have zero exact translation residual.

scope_boundary: Width four and the already-certified grade-one layer only.
This is an exact span/completion certificate, not yet an affine endpoint/Gram/source closure test for a new extended module.
No terminal-character family, random production, continuum field or physical Jordan interpretation is added.

compute_contract.arithmetic: Python standard-library exact integers and fractions
